sections.h2: What Is an ERPNext Health Check?

paragraphs.text: An ERPNext health check is a structured review of how your ERPNext system is set up and how well it is working. We look at speed, data quality, accounting and stock settings, user permissions, custom code, backups and tax configuration. You receive a written report within 3–5 working days, with every issue ranked by risk and effort.

It is useful whether ERPNext went live last month or five years ago, and whether we built it or another partner did. In short, it is an ERPNext setup review written for business owners, not just developers.

sections.intro: Every review starts with your busiest screens and reports, then moves through each area below.
rows: Slow screens, heavy reports, background jobs and server size
Chart of accounts, opening balances, period closing and tax accounts
Valuation method, negative stock, warehouse setup and ageing
Duplicate customers, suppliers and items; missing tax numbers
Roles, permissions, inactive users and admin access
Scripts and apps, especially changes made to core code
Backup frequency, restore tests, updates and two-factor login
GST or VAT templates, e-invoicing readiness and tax reports
sections.note: This ERPNext system audit covers both the technical side and the business side, because most problems sit where the two meet. The speed checks work as an ERPNext performance review, and the data checks act as an ERPNext data quality check for your masters and balances. We finish with an ERPNext configuration review of tax templates, naming and approval rules.

sections.h2: Who Is the Health Check For?
sections.intro: A free ERPNext health check is a good fit if:

items.text: Reports do not match your books, or month-end takes too long
ERPNext feels slow, especially for large reports
Your original partner has stopped responding
You are several versions behind and unsure about upgrading
Staff work around ERPNext in Excel because they do not trust it
You are about to add a new company, branch or country

outro.text: It also works as an ERPNext second opinion before you commit to a big customization or a full reimplementation.

rows: A 30-minute call to understand your business and concerns
Read-only access to your system for our team to check every area
A written report and a 30-minute walkthrough of the findings
sections.note: The first call works like a free ERPNext consultation: you explain what worries you, and we tell you what we will look at. After that, we only need a read-only user account. We do not change anything during the review, and you can remove our access the moment the report is delivered.

sections.intro: Your ERPNext assessment comes as a short, plain-language report:

items.text: Overall score for speed, data, accounts, stock, security and code
Top 10 issues, each ranked by risk and effort
Quick fixes your team can make in a day
Larger fixes with an estimated time and cost
Upgrade advice if you are behind the current version

outro.text: It shows where the problems are and what each fix involves. Many clients use the report as an ERPNext gap analysis for budgeting, even if they fix everything in-house.

sections.intro: These issues come up again and again, even in systems that seem to work well:

items.text: Stock valued at the wrong rate because of negative stock entries
Duplicate customers splitting sales history and credit limits
Former staff who can still log in
Backups that run but have never been tested
Custom changes made directly in core code, which block upgrades
Tax templates that no longer match current GST or VAT rules

outro.text: Most of these take less than a day to fix once they are found. The hard part is knowing where to look, and that is exactly what a free ERPNext health check is for.

paragraphs.html: You decide. Some clients fix the quick wins themselves. Others ask us to handle the larger items through ERPNext customization or move to a monthly ERPNext support plan. Either way, the report is yours to keep and share.

paragraphs.text: Because most businesses we help started with a small problem they could not explain. A clear review is the fastest way to show how we work. There is no sales pressure: if your system is healthy, we will tell you that too.
Our ERPNext health check service is available online everywhere, and in person in Kochi.
Book an ERPNext health check Kochi businesses can attend in person at our Vyttila office, or online. Our ERPNext health check Kerala clients include traders, manufacturers and service firms.
The ERPNext health check India-wide service runs fully online, with GST settings reviewed in detail.
The ERPNext health check GCC service covers VAT, Arabic print formats and e-invoicing readiness, with slots in Gulf working hours.

items.q: Is the ERPNext health check really free?
items.a: Yes. This free ERPNext review includes the call, the review and the written report at no cost, and there is no obligation to hire us afterwards. We offer a limited number of slots each month, so booking early helps.
A read-only user account for your ERPNext system. For a speed review, we may also ask for read-only server details. We never change data during the check, and you can remove access at any time.
Your team spends about an hour in total: a 30-minute call at the start and a 30-minute walkthrough at the end. The written report arrives within 3–5 working days of the first call.

items.q: Do we have to hire you afterwards?
items.a: No. The report is yours to keep. Many clients fix the quick wins themselves, and some ask us for help with the larger items.

items.q: Is this the same as a full ERPNext audit?
items.a: It covers the most important checks in a short time, which is why many people call it a free ERPNext audit. A paid, deeper ERPNext audit services engagement adds full transaction testing and detailed fixes, if you need it after the free review.

items.q: Can you check a system another partner built?
items.a: Yes. That is one of the most common requests. An ERPNext implementation review of another partner's work shows what is solid, what is risky and what needs fixing.
